limitations: The controlled synthetic failure reproduces q13's misleading missing-venv message under measured process exhaustion; it does not prove every historical q13 failure cause.

48 idle threads approximate parent overhead; they are not a replay of the model process. The paired512/1024 probes use fresh generated caches and identical scene/script/namespace settings apart from the cgroup limit and owned paths.

Only lane0 ran the48-thread paired-capacity test. The other three lanes independently passed the real renderer-to-CPU-physics route without artificial parent overhead; both hosts independently enforce the same new hard limit.
The readiness image is a64px blank probe used to initialize the actual renderer. The separately qualified four640x480 visible GPU images remain the rendering evidence.
Native cooking warnings are retained verbatim. Synthetic analytic-cube stepping does not qualify CAD cooking, workflow task acceptance, all registered validators, GPU PhysX or benchmark outcomes.
Resource/time measurements were not a performance benchmark and shared instantaneous machine load was not controlled.
scope: Actual same-session OVRTX readiness then native explicit-CPU constructor and usd-cli physics simulation in the qualified author namespace. Synthetic fixtures only.
